corrections.reason: The word is 'አንጽቶ' (having purified/cleansed his clothes, from አነጻ), visually confirmed by the top loop of 'ጽ' in the zoomed image.

Canonical Ge'ez root text (Acts 18:27) and the immediate gloss on L27 ('ቢጹ ፡ አቂላና ፡ ጵርስቅላ ፡ ናቸው') confirm 'ቢጹ' (his brethren/companions), visible in the image with the right-side vowel mark on both characters.
